productBanner.heading: NMC Verification API
productBanner.tagline: Instantly Verify Medical Professional Registration in Real Time

inlineImageAndParagraph.text: NMC Verification confirms if a medical professional is registered with India's National Medical Commission (NMC), the body regulating medical education and practice. Decentro's NMC Verification API instantly validates a doctor's credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official registry, returning name, qualification, and status in real time, without document uploads or manual review.

items.description: Initiate the verification process by securely providing the NMC registration number of the medical professional, ensuring accurate input for the subsequent validation against the official registry.
Decentro queries the official NMC database in real time, extracting the doctor's name, qualification, registration date, and current status directly from the source registry.
Receive a structured, comprehensive response with verification status and complete practitioner data, enabling instant, informed decision-making for onboarding workflows.
